t: Shesh teqiot shehayu toqein beereb shabbat
s: Shesh teqiot shehayu toqein beereb shabbat ubo seip echad: keshehayu yisrael beyishshuban tiqqenu chakamim litqoa shesh teqiot bemaqom gaboah, lehabdil haam min hammelaka. Veakshav nahagu biqhillot haqqedoshot shekkol shehu samuk leshabbat kachatzi shaa o shaa, shemmakriz sheliach tzibbur lehakin atzman leshabbat, shetztzarik lehosip mechol al haqqodesh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rs"a. Veken rauy linhog bekol maqom (shemmeacharim tepillat arbit). Veal kol panim tzarik lishloach ish lebattel habbaale melakot mimmelaktam min hammincha ulemala, dehaynu shette shaot umechetza qodem hallayla, al derek shennitbaer besimman rn"a. Vegam peraqmatya, ap shehi mutteret achar hammincha kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom rauy lishloach ish lisgor hachanuyyot kemo shaa qodem hallayla, ki peamim rabbot yotze mehen makshela gedola, shellipamim ba sar echad venimshak hammassa umattan ad hallayla mammash, vehaqqolar taluy betzavvar rashe haam, kemo sheddareshu chakamim mimmah shenneemar "vaasimem berashekem". Vegam tzarik lehazhir rob haam sheyyesh lahem hetter shekkol od shello ameru "bareku" osin kol hatztzarik lahem leshabbat ap al pi shehu layla mammash. Velaken yesh lehaqdim amirat "bareku", veen lehamtin al adam gadol sheadayin lo ba lebet hakkeneset, ki zekut hu lo shello yitchallel shabbat al yado, vehechakam enayv berosho:
